scope: AC1021 fixed-type LWPOLYLINE without strings: add the absent-string bit before existing alignment. Other entities, versions, handle streams and public APIs unchanged.
authority: ODA DWG v5.4.1 §20.1 defines the final pre-handle string-present flag. The producer width sample has last width ending at bit 652 and RL boundary 653; no strings are present. The old generated sample ends its last width at bit 784 and sets RL=784; LibreDWG reports a -1-bit handle-stream overshoot. The corrected sample preserves the widths, adds the zero marker and existing alignment, and sets RL=792.
producer: Scratch controls authored with ezdxf 1.4.5; ODA File Converter 27.1.0 converted them to AC1021 DWG and then AC1027 DXF. `closed` and `rich` were re-authored using explicit close=True after finding the first author invocation defaulted them to open; only corrected controls are used for those modes. All source/candidate field and graph checks use SHA-bound DWG/DXF pairs. ODA lineage is the separately observed conversion, not established by hashes alone.
fields: Three OCS XY points (0,0),(5,0),(5,3); width-only has (.2,.4),(.4,.1),(0,0) widths. Other samples individually cover bulges .25/-.5, per-vertex widths, closed+plinegen, constant width .6, and elevation 2/thickness .5/extrusion (0,1,0), with a rich combination. The source width stream stores two width entries and the generated stream stores a third explicit zero pair; the external DXF shows the same three vertex values. WCS vertices are independently checked, with tilted normal projecting to (0,2,0),(-5,2,0),(-5,2,3).
outcomes: Baseline width produces an ODA error file, no DXF and 19 preceding warnings; the fatal identifies AcDbPolyline handle 0x36. Marker-only candidate produces DXF with exact fields and no .err. The other five sampled generated DWGs are byte-identical before/after; source and corrected outputs for all six pass graph, field and DXF/WCS checks. ODA conversion logs are empty, but baseline .err is explicitly retained as the failure signal.
validation: Clean isolated -Werror source build; focused frame and peer-negative CTests 2/2. Frame control inspects widths and aligned scalar end, absent bit, CRC/receipt, body-level reconstructed historical frame parse (not a resealed full-frame CRC), truncation/reset/retry, decoded following LINE, and failed-write retry. Red control against exact prior writer fails; restored candidate passes. Hash-bound LibreDWG 0.14 + ezdxf 1.4.5 audit passes 12/12 source/candidate pairs. Three fixture-free peer negatives pass Python and Python -O.
reproduction: Compile tools/probe_ac1021_lwpolyline_footer.cpp against clean candidate libdxfrw, generate MODE into new DWG; modes bulge,width,closed,tilt,rich,constant.

Author controls with tools/author_ac1021_lwpolyline_footer.py EMPTY_DIR, then ODAFileConverter source-in source-dwg ACAD2007 DWG 0 1 '*.dxf'; ODAFileConverter DWG_DIR DXF_DIR ACAD2013 DXF 0 1 '*.dwg'.

Run tools/audit_ac1021_lwpolyline_footer.py --mode MODE --dwgread /opt/homebrew/bin/dwgread --dwg FILE --dwg-sha256 HASH --dxf FILE --dxf-sha256 HASH under the ezdxf 1.4.5 interpreter; use source or candidate hashes from this receipt.
limits: A source producer can preserve a shorter widths array; no claim of matching raw width-array length or byte identity.
Only these sampled OCS profiles, graph opt-ins and target conversion are evidenced; no general DWG or native application interoperability claim.
No fixture committed; all binary artifacts and diagnostic traces are scratch-only.
